items.text: Link the tools you already use, from forms and sheets to email and chat, without a developer.

items.title: A log for every run

items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The trial lasts 14 days and includes all Growth features. You do not need a credit card to start it.

items.q: Do I need to write code?
items.a: No. Flows are built by picking a trigger and adding steps on a canvas. If a step needs a value, you pick it from a list.
Forms, sheets, email, chat, shops and calendars, among others. The connector list grows every month.

items.q: What happens if a step fails?
items.a: The run stops, the log shows exactly which step failed and why, and the flow retries once on its own.

items.q: Can a flow wait for approval?
items.a: Yes. Add an approval step and the flow pauses until a teammate approves or declines it.

items.q: Is my data shared between apps?
items.a: Only the fields your flow maps are passed between apps. Flowlink does not copy your whole database.
Yes. The interface is fully bilingual, Arabic and English, including right to left layout.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: Your flows pause and your data stays. Pick a plan to turn them back on. Nothing is deleted.
